# System Lab owned companion presentation runtime

Copyright © 2026 Michele Giletto. All rights reserved.

The browser presentation modules and two original mascot images in this directory are reproduced byte-for-byte from the owner's already distributed Multiagentic Platform installation (directory identifier `1.1.25-rc.31-91768008c6`), under the owner's explicit authorisation to reuse this technology in System Lab Airspace Operations. The changing installation's package version was observed as `1.1.25-rc.50` earlier and `1.1.25-rc.51` later. Neither is asserted as a synchronously verified version at the copy event; the five file checksums in `provenance.json` identify this exact frozen subset.

These existing proprietary files are excluded from the Apache-2.0 licence for newly authored Airspace Operations code. Their inclusion does not grant a general right to redistribute, modify, sublicense or reuse the artwork or runtime in another product. Existing rights and applicable source-distribution terms remain reserved. Third-party rights are not altered.

`provenance.json` identifies each copied file, byte count, checksum and installed source version. The fresh React adapter in `src/CompanionArtwork.tsx` and `src/companionRuntime.ts` is separate newly authored application code. No trading engine, broker adapter, model weights, account data, private configuration or training implementation is included in this presentation component.

Only Indigo (`mascot-01`) and Coral (`mascot-06`) are exposed by the application. The byte-identical catalogue retains unused source-distribution metadata and presentation copy; that copy is not displayed by Airspace Operations. The renderer makes local static-image requests and has no operational or external communication permissions.
